g.text: bangle-static-booter
A one-file attempt to inspect the Bangle.js boot file so the
if
s that stop it being overwritten could be restored. It fetches, parses and counts — it never writes anything back.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`python generate.py` · no arguments, no options, no output file · the only way to run it
`README.md` · one line about restoring `if`s so the boot file stops updating · no code behind it
`requests.get` on the raw bootupdate.js URL from BangleApps master · unpinned, so today it reads whatever upstream has now
`esprima.parseScript(text, delegate=visitor)` · the delegate walks the tree during parsing and counts
`visitor.visit(syntaxTree)` walks the same tree a second time · the result is printed, and `NodeVisitor.visit` returns None
`bootCount` is a module-level global incremented on every `boot += ...` assignment expression
`bootCount` · in RAM, starts at 0, doubled by the second walk
stdout only · a count and a None, nothing saved, nothing compared
`raw.githubusercontent.com/espruino/BangleApps/master/apps/boot/bootupdate.js` · the file that owns the boot loader
`requests` and `esprima` · no requirements.txt, no pin, so the esprima delegate API is whatever pip installs
one run
a count
one HTTP GET
